evidence.title: Godly Templates Inspiration — Curated Website & Framer Templates

name: Godly.Design
summary: Curated design inspiration gallery: websites, apps, app icons, logos, OG images, templates and website sections.
description: A curated gallery of web, app, UI and visual design work published around the internet. Browse websites, posts, tools, resources, templates, apps, app icons, logos and OG images, or dive into section-level inspiration for hero, CTA, footer and navbar designs; every item links to the original work, and items can be opened in v0, ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor for use as reference. Submission is open and review-based.
contains: galleries: trending, websites, posts, tools, resources, templates, apps, app icons, logos, OG images
section inspiration: hero, CTA and footer (also navbar, pricing and FAQ examples)
163 templates listed with creator and price (some free)
keyboard navigation: arrows to move, enter to open, cmd+J to preview
open any item in chat, v0, ChatGPT, Claude, T3 Chat, Scira or Cursor
submit a website, app, logo, post, tool or portfolio for review
